### PE_MSQ_01: Which of the following are primary animal tissue types? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Epithelial tissue
- [ ] B) Connective tissue
- [ ] C) Vascular tissue only
- [ ] D) Muscular tissue
- [ ] E) Nervous tissue

> **✅ Answers:** A) Epithelial tissue, B) Connective tissue, D) Muscular tissue, E) Nervous tissue
> **Explanation:** 4 primary tissues: Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, Nervous.

### PE_MSQ_02: Select all cell junctions present in epithelial tissue:

- [ ] A) Tight junction
- [ ] B) Adherens junction
- [ ] C) Desmosome
- [ ] D) Gap junction
- [ ] E) Synaptic knob

> **✅ Answers:** A) Tight junction, B) Adherens junction, C) Desmosome, D) Gap junction
> **Explanation:** Epithelial junctions: Tight, Adherens, Desmosome, Gap.

### PE_MSQ_03: Which components are part of formed elements in blood? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Erythrocytes (RBC)
- [ ] B) Leucocytes (WBC)
- [ ] C) Thrombocytes (Platelets)
- [ ] D) Albumins
- [ ] E) Fibrinogen

> **✅ Answers:** A) Erythrocytes (RBC), B) Leucocytes (WBC), C) Thrombocytes (Platelets)
> **Explanation:** Formed elements = RBC, WBC, Platelets; Albumins & Fibrinogen are plasma proteins.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Which components are part of formed elem" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

- [ ] A) Voluntary control
- [ ] B) Syncytial multinucleated

> **✅ Answers:** A) Voluntary control, B) Syncytial multinucleated, C) Striated bands, E) Fatigues quickly
> **Explanation:** Skeletal muscle is voluntary, striated, syncytial, fatigues.

### PE_MSQ_06: Which types of fibres occur in Connective Tissue Proper? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Collagen white fibres
- [ ] B) Yellow elastic fibres
- [ ] C) Reticular network fibres
- [ ] D) Myofibril protein fibres
- [ ] E) Axon nerve fibres

> **✅ Answers:** A) Collagen white fibres, B) Yellow elastic fibres, C) Reticular network fibres
> **Explanation:** 3 fibre types in CT Proper: Collagen, Elastic, Reticular.

### MSQ_P_E_07: Which of the following are functions of Epithelial Tissue? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Protection
- [ ] B) Secretion
- [ ] C) Absorption
- [ ] D) Contraction
- [ ] E) Gaseous diffusion

> **✅ Answers:** A) Protection, B) Secretion, C) Absorption, E) Gaseous diffusion
> **Explanation:** Epithelium protects, secretes, absorbs, and diffuses gases. Contraction = muscular tissue.

### MSQ_P_E_09: Which elements form the ground substance matrix of Connective Tissue? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Mucopolysaccharides (Hyaluronic acid)
- [ ] B) Glycoproteins
- [ ] C) Water and mineral salts
- [ ] D) Actin filaments
- [ ] E) Proteoglycans

> **✅ Answers:** A) Mucopolysaccharides (Hyaluronic acid), B) Glycoproteins, C) Water and mineral salts, E) Proteoglycans
> **Explanation:** CT matrix = Hyaluronic acid, glycoproteins, water, minerals, proteoglycans.

### MSQ_P_E_10: Select all features belonging to Smooth Muscle Tissue:

- [ ] A) Spindle-shaped fusiform myocytes
- [ ] B) Single central nucleus
- [ ] C) Involuntary autonomic control
- [ ] D) Transverse striations
- [ ] E) Slow sustained contractions

> **✅ Answers:** A) Spindle-shaped fusiform myocytes, B) Single central nucleus, C) Involuntary autonomic control, E) Slow sustained contractions
> **Explanation:** Smooth muscle is spindle-shaped, uninucleated, involuntary, unstriated, slow-contracting.
